description: returnReserves (V2 vault): every guard and effect of the permissionless return of a closed vault's reserves, each deleted or weakened alone, against the suite that pins it on the v3 unit model and on the v3 and v4 bytecode deployed on Base.
provenance: Authored 2026-10-02 with returnReserves, after the V1 incident of 2 Oct 2026 (an owner closed an automated position on Uniswap and the collected fees stayed in the vault). Run: node scripts/mutate-contracts.mjs contracts/mutations/v2-return-reserves-2026-10-02.json --with-artifacts

a move in token1 alone advances the nonce

what the owner cannot receive stays idle

the owner is the payee, whoever calls
